test_cases.description: getProjectManifest returns a ProjectManifest with all required fields and correct types
getProjectManifest returns exactly 12 files matching ScaffoldFilePath enum
assertions: every ScaffoldFilePath variant is present in manifest.files

test_cases.description: getProjectManifest returns projectName === 'exemplar-tools-doc'
getProjectManifest returns devServerPort === 4000
getProjectManifest projectName matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*$
getProjectManifest is pure and returns identical results on repeated calls
assertions: two sequential calls return deeply equal results

test_cases.description: getRequiredDependencies returns dependencies and devDependencies arrays
getRequiredDependencies returns exactly 3 dependencies and 13 devDependencies
getRequiredDependencies dependencies contain react, react-dom, react-router-dom with ^18.3/^6.23 ranges
getRequiredDependencies devDependencies contain all 13 required packages
assertions: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, tailwindcss, vitest, @testing-library/react, @testing-library/jest-dom, jsdom, prism-react-renderer, autoprefixer, postcss, typescript, @types/react, @types/react-dom all present

test_cases.description: Each DependencyEntry has packageName, versionRange, isDev with correct types
isDev is false for dependencies and true for devDependencies
assertions: all dependencies entries have isDev === false
all devDependencies entries have isDev === true

test_cases.description: Every packageName matches ^@?[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*(\/?[a-z][a-z0-9\-]*)*$
Every versionRange matches ^[\^~>=<\d\|\s\.\-\*]+.*$
No duplicate packageNames across dependencies and devDependencies
No dependency uses 'latest' or bare '*' as version range
getRequiredDependencies is pure and returns identical results on repeated calls
assertions: two sequential calls return deeply equal results

test_cases.description: generateScaffold writes all 12 files and returns correct ScaffoldResult
generateScaffold with overwrite=false throws file_already_exists when files exist
generateScaffold with overwrite=true succeeds even when files already exist
generateScaffold throws directory_not_found when parent directory does not exist
generateScaffold throws invalid_output_dir when outputDir is empty string
generateScaffold throws invalid_output_dir when outputDir contains null bytes
After generateScaffold, no .js files exist in output directory tree
After generateScaffold, no .py files exist in output directory tree
Generated package.json has type: module
Generated vite.config.ts configures server.port = 4000
Generated vitest.setup.ts contains import '@testing-library/jest-dom'
Generated vercel.json has exactly one rewrite: source=/(.*), destination=/index.html
assertions: vercel.json parsed has rewrites array of length 1

test_cases.description: Generated index.html has div#root and module script pointing to /src/main.tsx
Generated src/main.tsx imports React, ReactDOM, App, and index.css
Generated src/index.css contains @tailwind base, components, utilities directives
Generated src/App.tsx has both named export and default export
assertions: App.tsx contains export function or export const

test_cases.description: Generated postcss.config.mjs uses export default (ESM), not module.exports
Generated tailwind.config.ts content array includes ./index.html and ./src/**/*.{ts,tsx}
validateScaffold returns valid result after generateScaffold completes
assertions: result.isValid === true or all checks pass

test_cases.description: validateScaffold throws directory_not_found for non-existent directory
validateScaffold reports invalid when a scaffold file is deleted
assertions: result.isValid is false or missing file check fails

test_cases.description: validateScaffold reports invalid for an empty directory
End-to-end: generate, validate, and structurally inspect generated config files
